## Bottom line

- The register gives partial evidence for two of the three ISO 45001 clauses shown; the organisation must still show its own records for management review. [FND-0001; FND-0002]

Aid to assurance, not a compliance opinion.

## What the learnings show, requirement by requirement

**Learning:** The pump went back into service without a leak test, because no return-to-service step required one. [FND-0001; EVD-0001]

ISO 45001 clause 8.1 (operational planning and control): the learning shows no return-to-service test for pressure-boundary work. The organisation must still show its own return-to-service procedure and records.

*(learning: LR-01; Clauses: ISO45001-8.1)*

**Learning:** The missing restart checklist was never raised as a corrective action after earlier seal leaks. [FND-0002; EVD-0002]

ISO 45001 clause 10.2 (incident, nonconformity and corrective action): the learning shows earlier leaks fixed without a corrective action. The organisation must still show how it records and reviews corrective actions.

*(learning: LR-02; Clauses: ISO45001-10.2)*

## Requirements not checked against the primary text

One of the three rows carries "(unverified)": its id and title were not checked against the primary text of the standard. Confirm it against the current edition before using the crosswalk in an audit.
